cells.gaps: No row on this instrument says it was approved, adopted, launched or drafted; sources only name it as existing, with period 2020-2030, and text public is not stated, so standing is not established. The World Bank (2023) both cites the strategy and says there is no comprehensive national digital strategy (TCD-003), and recommends adopting 'Chad Digital Strategy Horizon 2030' (TCD-004, drafting), which may be the same document but is a different named instrument. Tchad Connexion 2030 (national development plan and economic strategy) is also held. Needed for stage 3: a source word of adoption and a public text; no reporting row.
cells.note: Instrument: Stratégie nationale de transformation numérique 2020-2030. Its rows give period, a roadmap of undated targets and a mandated body, but none sets a standing, so no rung is reached.
